description:
The kernel packages contain the Linux kernel, the core of any Linux operating system.  

Security Fix(es):  

  * kernel: net/smc: fix UAF in smc_cdc_rx_handler() by pinning the socket (CVE-2026-64541)
  * kernel: s390/zcrypt: Validate length for CCA AES cipher key requests (CVE-2026-68452)
  * kernel: s390/zcrypt: Validate length for CCA ECC private key requests (CVE-2026-68451)
  * kernel: wifi: mac80211: validate extension-frame layout before RX (CVE-2026-68470)
  * kernel: net: qrtr: fix 32-bit integer overflow in qrtr_endpoint_post() (CVE-2026-72298)
  * kernel: wifi: brcmfmac: cyw: fix heap overflow on a short auth frame (CVE-2026-72003)
  * kernel: drm/amdkfd: hold event_mutex while checkpointing CRIU events (CVE-2026-74446)
  * kernel: net: bridge: stop fast-leave after deleting a port group (CVE-2026-74480)
  * kernel: net/smc: fix socket use-after-free during link group termination (CVE-2026-74493)
  * kernel: ipv6: fix use-after-free in ip6_finish_output2() (CVE-2026-80792)
  * kernel: drm/amdkfd: fix SMI event cross-process information leak (CVE-2026-97422)
  * kernel: drm/amd/pm: bound pp_dpm_set_pp_table() memcpy (CVE-2026-97427)
  * kernel: drm/amdkfd: Check bounds for allocate_sdma_queue restore_sdma_id (CVE-2026-97497)
  * kernel: drm/amdgpu: validate and share PSP fw_pri_buf copies via psp_copy_fw (CVE-2026-97494)
  * kernel: drm/amdkfd: Check bounds on allocate_doorbell (CVE-2026-97495)
  * kernel: drm/amdgpu: Bound GPIO I2C table entry count from VBIOS (CVE-2026-97493)
  * kernel: drm/amdgpu: fix buffer overflow during vBIOS update (CVE-2026-97425)
  * kernel: drm/amdkfd: Fix OOB memory exposure in get_wave_state() (CVE-2026-97496)
  * kernel: ALSA: pcm: Serialize PCM mmap with buffer reallocation to fix page UAF (CVE-2026-98116)
  * kernel: ALSA: ua101: reject mismatched capture/playback packet sizes (CVE-2026-98741)
  * kernel: net/smc: protect clcsock lifetime in smc_getname (CVE-2026-99032)
  * kernel: kernel: Denial of Service via premature connection tracking expiration on TCP RST packets (CVE-2026-99283)


Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):  

  * Backport CVEs from v7.2 [rhel-10.3.z] (JIRA:RHEL-291553)


For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
